What is shaping today’s global energy landscape?

Recent geopolitical tensions have exposed just how fragile global energy systems remain—driving price spikes of up to 50% and disrupting flows that underpin nearly 20% of the global market. Yet at the same time, a new reality is emerging: demand is surging, investment is rising, and the pressure to act has never been greater.

At the @UN-Energy meeting in Geneva, the conversation shifted decisively toward solutions and what comes next. The focus was not only on the challenges—but on the opportunity windows opening within this disruption.

Because within every moment of uncertainty lies a choice: to react, or to transform.

With just a few years to 2030, the question is no longer whether we have the tools—but whether we are ready to turn opportunity into delivery, and ambition into results.
